# <span id="aanchor215"></span> Exception Directory

## 100 - 106

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00100">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />100 SV - Standard values</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00100">

Standard values (SV) exceptions are related to the limits and constants that are defined in [System Factors](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Factors.md). FLOWCAL will generate SV exceptions to alert users if a constant is outside of a calculation range, or if the flow data is not within the limits defined at the system level.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00103">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />103 SV - System constant base pressure out of range</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00103">

This exception is generated when the pressure base identified in [System Factors](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Factors.md) is out of range. FLOWCAL checks that the system pressure base is within the range of 12–16.1 psi, converting for units when the pressure base unit is not in psi. Common reasons for this exception to be generated would be for the base pressure to be outside of the 12–16.1 psi range or the pressure base unit to be incorrect. You can check your pressure base unit in the Settings Manager under [Unit Assignment](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/Unit%20Assignment.md).

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00104">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />104 SV - System constant base temperature out of range</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00104">

This exception is generated when the temperature base identified in [System Factors](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Factors.md) is out of range. FLOWCAL checks that the system pressure base is within a range of 50–70°F, converting for units when the temperature base unit is not in degrees F. Common reasons for this exception to be generated would be for the base temperature to be outside of the 50–70°F range or the temperature base unit to be incorrect. You can check your temperature base unit in the Settings Manager under [Unit Assignment](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/Unit%20Assignment.md).

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00105">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />105 SV - Analysis total less than system constant low limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00105">

This exception is generated when the mol% total on a meter periodic record is lower than the limit set in Component Totals (Lo Limit) field in [System Factors](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Factors.md). For example: If the Component Totals (Lo Limit) is set to 99.90, but the analysis that is applied to a meter periodic totals to 98% for the mol% components, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="00106">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />106 SV - Analysis total greater than system constant high limit</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="00106">

This exception is generated when the mol% total on a meter periodic record is higher than the limit set in Component Totals (Hi Limit) field in [System Factors](../../../Settings%20Manager/System/System%20Factors.md). For example: If the Component Totals (Hi Limit) is set to 100, but the analysis that is applied to a meter periodic totals to 100.01% for the mol% components, then this exception will be generated.

</div>

</div>
